title: Grim Reaper and Cosmic Octopus
description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a dark blue hooded robe stands on a wooden boat, gesturing with one hand. A large, bright pink cartoonish octopus with big glossy eyes and a toothy grin sits beside him on the boat, which rests atop a grassy, rocky floating island in a surreal cosmic sky.
prompt: A skeletal Grim Reaper wearing a dark blue hooded robe and golden belt stands in an old wooden boat, one bony hand extended in a gesture. Next to him is a large vibrant pink octopus creature with huge shiny black eyes, a wide toothy grin, and multiple curling tentacles. The boat rests on a small floating rocky island covered in bright green moss and grass, set against a dramatic cosmic background with swirling green and purple nebulae, glowing stars, clouds, and a bright yellow celestial body.
